statement: An internal held-out test of the lymph node reference on laser-microdissected tonsil micro-regions (mixtures of the cells in 4,000 square micrometres), never external validation and never a single-cell accuracy. Tonsil is a secondary lymphoid organ but not a lymph node; every region comes from one section of one donor; the development set PXD047762 comes from the same lab and may share tonsils.
baselines: run before scoring by benchmark/baselines_corrected.py (lymph node option); see research/organ-references.md, Lymph node

rehearsal.what: RNA pseudobulk regions of the lymph node reference's test cells, written as a DIA-NN pg_matrix in Excel
